title: seeded spec-infidelity caught (a charter AC unimplemented or contradicted)
threshold: caught on every run; zero blocking-class misses
negative_example: a diff implementing a plausible-but-different behavior than the AC — the code looks reasonable and its own tests pass, but it does something OTHER than the acceptance criterion states.

legs.charter: AC-1 (Must): On a write failure, the persist path retries with bounded backoff up to 3 attempts, then records a review-absence and returns ErrPersist. It MUST NOT swallow the error or return success on a failed write.

expected_catch.message: AC-1 requires a bounded retry then a recorded review-absence and an ErrPersist return on write failure; the diff instead swallows the error and returns a nil error (success) on a failed write — the required behavior is inverted.
